“the stakes for our company has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our company have never been higher”
“federal goverment” >>> “federal government”
“more then ever” >>> “more than ever”
“has three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: Three cosponsors are stated, but only two are named.]
“it's definitions” >>> “its definitions”
“its central principal” >>> “its central principle”
“In brief, the bill:” >>> “In brief:”
“the bill's enforcment regime” >>> “the bill's enforcement regime”
“would directly effect every company” >>> “would directly affect every company”
“Senator Whitfield (R-OH)” / “Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: Whitfield’s state is inconsistent: Ohio or Oklahoma.]
“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> “narrows the registry in Section 4”
“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty in Section 5” >>> [CHECK: The bill summary specifies $1 million per day. Verify the amount and whether the amendment keeps or changes it.]
“who's support” >>> “whose support”
“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”
“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee’s 28 members”
“13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: These counts total 29, not the stated 28 members.]
“The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow” >>> [CHECK: Five senators are listed, but six are described as undecided. Kowalski and Ames are also described below as not having committed to a final position; reconcile the list and counts.]
“Thursday, October 14” >>> “Thursday, October 15”
“after the September 23 hearing” / “The committee's hearing on the impacts of deep-sea mining occured on September 30” >>> [CHECK: If these refer to the same hearing, reconcile September 23 and September 30.]
“in a seperate interview” >>> “in a separate interview”
“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached”
“Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”
“as soon as the week November 16” >>> “as soon as the week of November 16”
“occured on September 30” >>> “occurred on September 30”
“the treaty negotiations required by Section 6 would have to conclude within two years” >>> [CHECK: The Section 6 summary specifies 18 months, not two years.]
“a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “a close complement to S. 2817”
“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”
“call there senators” >>> “call their senators”
“should recieve updated talking points” >>> “should receive updated talking points”
“Our six regional policy leads” / “Each of our five regional policy leads” >>> [CHECK: Reconcile the number of regional policy leads: six or five.]
